chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi reported to me from Abul Qasim al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Marwan, from his father who reported from Ahmad ibn Isa, who reported from Muhammad ibn Ja'far, from his father Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, from his forefathers, peace be upon them all, who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:
Two traits never go together in a hypocrite: the true understanding of Islam, and the distinct feature of nobility in the face.
May Allah bless our master Muhammad the Prophet and his family, and grant them abundant peace.

key_terms.خَلَّتَانِ: Khallatan: two traits or qualities, referring to characteristics that define a person's faith
key_terms.سَمْتٍ: Samt: demeanor, bearing, or noble appearance that reflects inner piety
key_terms.فِقْهٌ: Fiqh: deep understanding and comprehension of Islamic teachings, beyond superficial knowledge
key_terms.مُنَافِقٍ: Munafiq: a hypocrite, one who outwardly professes Islam but lacks true faith inwardly

ai.seo_question: What two traits does the Prophet say are never found in a hypocrite according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This prophetic tradition, transmitted through a chain going back to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq and his forefathers (the Ahl al-Bayt), records the Prophet Muhammad's teaching that two positive qualities -- genuine Islamic scholarship and a dignified, noble countenance -- are never found together in a hypocrite. The hadith implies that true faith manifests both internally through deep religious understanding and externally through one's demeanor. The audience of early Muslims would have understood this as a practical criterion for discerning sincere believers from pretenders.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 5. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi reported to me from Abul Qasim al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali, from Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Marwan, from his father who reported from Ahmad ibn Isa, who reported from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, from his father Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, from his forefathers, peace be upon them all, who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: "
Two traits never go together in a hypocrite: the (true) learning about Islam, and the distinct feature (of nobility) in the face."
May Allah bless our master Muhammad and his progeny.
